title: Gesture-controlled wheelchair with hurdle detection
highlights: Designed a wheelchair control system using MEMS technology with an 8-bit ATmega32 microcontroller, improving accessibility for physically disabled users through hand gestures.

Wrote bare-metal C for the ATmega32 that reads a two-axis MEMS accelerometer through the on-chip ADC and maps tilt thresholds to forward, backward, left, right and stop outputs on a motor-driver port.
Added an obstacle input that stops the motors, shows an alert on a 16x2 LCD and backs the chair away, with live X and Y readings on the display and a UART receive interrupt for serial input.
